mapper.select:
select id, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events e
order by case when e.status in ('open', 'waitlist') and e.event_date >= curdate() then 0 when e.event_date >= curdate() then 1 else 2 end, case when e.event_date >= curdate() then e.event_date end asc, case when e.event_date < curdate() then e.event_date end desc, e.start_time asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(1) from cm_events e

select id, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events where id = #{id} limit 1 for update

select eai.id, eai.agenda_time as time, eai.sort_order as sortOrder, lf.field_name as fieldName, lf.value from cm_event_agenda_items eai left join cm_event_agenda_item_localized_fields lf on lf.agenda_item_id = eai.id and lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' and lf.field_name in ('title', 'description') where eai.event_id = #{eventId} order by eai.sort_order, lf.field_name, case lf.locale when #{locale} then 0 when 'zh' then 1 when 'en' then 2 else 3 end

select eni.id, eni.sort_order as sortOrder, coalesce( max(case when lf.locale = #{locale} and lf.field_name = 'title' then lf.value end), max(case when lf.locale = 'zh' and lf.field_name = 'title' then lf.value end), max(case when lf.locale = 'en' and lf.field_name = 'title' then lf.value end) ) as title, coalesce( max(case when lf.locale = #{locale} and lf.field_name = 'description' then lf.value end), max(case when lf.locale = 'zh' and lf.field_name = 'description' then lf.value end), max(case when lf.locale = 'en' and lf.field_name = 'description' then lf.value end) ) as description from cm_event_note_items eni left join cm_event_note_item_localized_fields lf on lf.note_item_id = eni.id and lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' and lf.field_name in ('title', 'description') where eni.event_id = #{eventId} group by eni.id, eni.sort_order having title is not null or description is not null order by eni.sort_order

select id, user_id as userId, event_id as eventId, entitlement_balance_id as entitlementBalanceId, status, requested_at as registeredAt, confirmed_at as confirmedAt, attended_at as attendedAt, event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt from cm_event_registrations where user_id = #{userId} and event_id = #{eventId} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, event_id as eventId, entitlement_balance_id as entitlementBalanceId, status, requested_at as registeredAt, confirmed_at as confirmedAt, attended_at as attendedAt, event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt from cm_event_registrations where user_id = #{userId} and event_id = #{eventId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_event_registrations (id, user_id, event_id, entitlement_balance_id, status, requested_at, confirmed_at, waitlisted_at, event_quota_consumed_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{eventId}, #{entitlementBalanceId}, #{status}, now(), case when #{status} = 'confirmed' then now() else null end, case when #{status} = 'waitlist' then now() else null end, case when #{consumeQuota} then now() else null end)
mapper.update: update cm_event_registrations set status = #{status}, requested_at = now(), confirmed_at = case when #{status} = 'confirmed' then now() else null end, declined_at = null, waitlisted_at = case when #{status} = 'waitlist' then now() else null end, cancelled_at = null, attended_at = null, entitlement_balance_id = #{entitlementBalanceId}, event_quota_consumed_at = case when #{consumeQuota} then now() else null end, event_quota_released_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('cancelled', 'declined')
update cm_event_registrations set status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status not in ('cancelled', 'attended')
update cm_event_registrations set event_quota_released_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and event_quota_consumed_at is not null and event_quota_released_at is null
mapper.select: select e.id, e.status, e.visibility, e.consumes_membership_quota, e.city_code, e.address_visibility, e.event_date, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.capacity, e.cover_image_url, e.created_at, e.updated_at, r.id as registrationId, r.status as registrationStatus from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by e.event_date desc

select e.id, e.status, e.visibility, e.consumes_membership_quota as consumesMembershipQuota, e.city_code as cityCode, e.address_visibility as addressVisibility, e.event_date as eventDate, e.start_time as startTime, e.end_time as endTime, e.capacity, e.cover_image_url as coverImageUrl, e.created_at as createdAt, e.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_events e where e.id = #{id}

select max(case when field_name = 'title' then value end) as title, max(case when field_name = 'summary' then value end) as summary, max(case when field_name = 'venue' then value end) as venue, max(case when field_name = 'address' then value end) as address, max(case when field_name = 'format' then value end) as format, max(case when field_name = 'audience' then value end) as audience from cm_event_localized_fields where event_id = #{eventId} and locale = #{locale} and field_name in ('title','summary','venue','address','format','audience')

select eai.id, eai.agenda_time as time, eai.sort_order as sortOrder, max(case when lf.field_name = 'title' then lf.value end) as title, max(case when lf.field_name = 'description' then lf.value end) as description from cm_event_agenda_items eai left join cm_event_agenda_item_localized_fields lf on lf.agenda_item_id = eai.id and lf.locale = #{locale} and lf.field_name in ('title', 'description') where eai.event_id = #{eventId} group by eai.id, eai.agenda_time, eai.sort_order order by eai.sort_order
select language_code from cm_event_language_codes where event_id = #{eventId} order by language_code
mapper.insert: insert into cm_events ( id, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{status}, #{visibility}, #{consumesMembershipQuota}, #{cityCode}, #{addressVisibility}, #{eventDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, #{coverImageUrl}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update cm_events set status = #{status}, visibility = #{visibility}, consumes_membership_quota = #{consumesMembershipQuota}, city_code = #{cityCode}, address_visibility = #{addressVisibility}, event_date = #{eventDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, capacity = #{capacity}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'draft'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_event_relationship_focuses ( id, event_id, focus_order, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{focusOrder}, #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', now(), now() )

insert into cm_event_localized_fields ( id, event_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', now(), now() )

insert into cm_event_localized_fields ( id, event_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', now(), now() ) on duplicate key update value = values(value), source = 'manual', provider = 'human', status = 'ready', updated_at = now()

insert into cm_event_agenda_item_localized_fields ( id, agenda_item_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{agendaItemId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', now(), now() )

insert into cm_event_note_item_localized_fields ( id, note_item_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{noteItemId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', now(), now() )
mapper.update: update cm_events set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from cm_event_registrations where event_id = #{eventId} and status in ('confirmed', 'attended')

select sum(case when status = 'confirmed' then 1 else 0 end) as confirmedCount, sum(case when status = 'attended' then 1 else 0 end) as attendedCount, sum(case when status = 'waitlist' then 1 else 0 end) as waitlistCount from cm_event_registrations where event_id = #{eventId}

select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.event_id as eventId, r.entitlement_balance_id as entitlementBalanceId, r.status, r.requested_at as requestedAt, r.confirmed_at as confirmedAt, r.declined_at as declinedAt, r.waitlisted_at as waitlistedAt, r.cancelled_at as cancelledAt, r.attended_at as attendedAt, r.event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, r.event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt, u.account_name as userAccountName, lf.value as eventTitle, e.event_date as eventDate, e.capacity, e.consumes_membership_quota as consumesMembershipQuota from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id left join cm_users u on u.id = r.user_id left join cm_event_localized_fields lf on lf.event_id = e.id and lf.field_name = 'title' and lf.locale = 'zh' where r.id = #{id}

select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.event_id as eventId, r.entitlement_balance_id as entitlementBalanceId, r.status, r.requested_at as requestedAt, r.confirmed_at as confirmedAt, r.declined_at as declinedAt, r.waitlisted_at as waitlistedAt, r.cancelled_at as cancelledAt, r.attended_at as attendedAt, r.event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, r.event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_event_registrations r where r.id = #{id} for update

select id from cm_user_entitlement_balances where user_id = #{userId} and membership_id = #{membershipId} and entitlement_code = 'event_registration' and period_started_at <= now() and period_ends_at > now() and quota_remaining > 0 order by period_ends_at limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update cm_user_entitlement_balances set quota_used = quota_used + 1, quota_remaining = quota_remaining - 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{balanceId} and quota_remaining > 0

update cm_user_entitlement_balances set quota_used = greatest(quota_used - 1, 0), quota_remaining = least(quota_remaining + 1, quota_total), updated_at = now() where id = #{balanceId} and quota_used > 0 and quota_remaining < quota_total

update cm_event_registrations set status = #{status}, requested_at = case when #{status} = 'requested' then now() else requested_at end, confirmed_at = case when #{status} = 'confirmed' and confirmed_at is null then now() else confirmed_at end, declined_at = case when #{status} = 'declined' then now() else declined_at end, waitlisted_at = case when #{status} = 'waitlist' then now() else waitlisted_at end, cancelled_at = case when #{status} = 'cancelled' then now() else cancelled_at end, attended_at = case when #{status} = 'attended' then now() else attended_at end,
entitlement_balance_id = #{entitlementBalanceId}, event_quota_consumed_at = now(), event_quota_released_at = null,
event_quota_released_at = now(),
updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select r.user_id as userId, e.id as eventId, timestamp(e.event_date, e.start_time) as startsAt, coalesce( (select lf.value from cm_event_localized_fields lf where lf.event_id = e.id and lf.field_name = 'title' and lf.locale = u.preferred_locale and lf.status = 'ready' limit 1), (select lf.value from cm_event_localized_fields lf where lf.event_id = e.id and lf.field_name = 'title' and lf.locale = 'zh' and lf.status = 'ready' limit 1), e.id ) as eventTitle from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id join cm_users u on u.id = r.user_id and u.status = 'active' left join cm_user_preferences p on p.user_id = r.user_id where r.status = 'confirmed' and e.status not in ('draft', 'hidden', 'completed') and coalesce(p.event_reminders_enabled, 1) = 1 and timestamp(e.event_date, e.start_time) > now() and timestamp(e.event_date, e.start_time) <= date_add(now(), interval 24 hour) order by e.event_date, e.start_time, r.id limit #{batchSize}

select e.id from cm_events e where e.status in ('open', 'waitlist', 'closed') and ( timestamp(e.event_date, e.end_time) <= now() or ( timestamp(e.event_date, e.end_time) > now() and e.status in ('open', 'waitlist') and (select count(*) from cm_event_registrations occupied where occupied.event_id = e.id and occupied.status in ('confirmed', 'attended')) < e.capacity and exists ( select 1 from cm_event_registrations pending where pending.event_id = e.id and pending.status in ('requested', 'waitlist') ) ) ) order by e.event_date, e.end_time, e.id limit #{batchSize}

select id, user_id as userId, event_id as eventId, entitlement_balance_id as entitlementBalanceId, status, requested_at as requestedAt, confirmed_at as confirmedAt, declined_at as declinedAt, waitlisted_at as waitlistedAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt, attended_at as attendedAt, event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id where r.event_id = #{eventId} and r.status in ('requested', 'waitlist') and ( e.consumes_membership_quota = 0 or exists ( select 1 from cm_user_memberships m join cm_user_entitlement_balances b on b.membership_id = m.id and b.user_id = m.user_id and b.entitlement_code = 'event_registration' and b.period_started_at <= now() and b.period_ends_at > now() and b.quota_remaining > 0 where m.user_id = r.user_id and m.status = 'active' and m.started_at <= now() and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now()) ) ) order by r.requested_at, r.id limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update cm_event_registrations set status = 'attended', attended_at = now(), updated_at = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 'confirmed'
update cm_events set status = 'completed', updated_at = now() where id = #{eventId} and status in ('open', 'waitlist', 'closed') and timestamp(event_date, end_time) <= now()
